convert_metaclip2_checkpoint: convert a MetaCLIP 2 checkpoint to Hugging Face format using the convert_metaclip_2_to_hf.py script
create_hf_config: create a MetaClip2Config with vision and text config parameters from a MetaCLIP model name
convert_state_dict: convert a MetaCLIP state dict to Hugging Face format by mapping and splitting qkv projections
verify_conversion: verify that a converted MetaCLIP 2 model produces matching outputs against the original checkpoint
push_to_hub: push a converted MetaCLIP 2 model and processor to a Hugging Face Hub repository
